parameters.content:
## Lokalise push :eyes: -> Claude (DRAFT, inactive)

Every 2 min reads 3 days of history in the 7 automation channels. A post matches when it contains "pushed to Lokalise" (not "cleanup mode") and has an :eyes: reaction. For each new match it posts at the channel TOP LEVEL: `@Claude run the lokalise-keys-jira-trace skill on this Lokalise push: <permalink>`. Top level because Claude Tag answers a bot's @Claude only there, not inside a thread. No approval step: Claude writes empty fields only.

Once per push: skipped when an ask with that permalink is already in the channel, or the push is in static data. Marked done only after Slack accepts the post.

**Before publishing:** the i18n assignment bot and Claude must be members of all 7 channels; Respond automatically on; the plugin with lokalise-keys-jira-trace plus Jira and n8n connectors attached in Claude Tag. Unpublish the old watcher 4BddlBFNRGJL5rqk and the Slack Workflow Builder "Jira key trace" workflow (also on :eyes:).
